_comment: Extra real-GPU WebGL identities for cfm/cfox. A GPU is listed only if Firefox has actually been recorded reporting it on that OS; the renderer strings real Firefox emits are the ones Gecko's SanitizeRenderer keeps, so modern model names (RTX 3050/4060, GTX 1050) are absent by design -- no real Firefox shows them. webgl_data is generated from fpgen's pinned model.

source.generator: cfm-cli extras generator (fpgen trace: target=gpu/webgl/webgl2, browser=Firefox, os=Linux)
